method: Publicly distributed extension package downloaded for static protocol inspection. No installed browser/profile/runtime state accessed or changed. No upstream extension code or runtime is bundled in AntiSocial. Kotlin service models, transport and Compose UI independently implemented.
upstream_license: No explicit reusable source license identified in the inspected package; do not assume GPL or redistribute extension code.
identity: Observed public anonymous Firebase client flow, created lazily for explicit writes only. Distributed client project identifier is not a server secret. Refresh preserves existing UID. No paid developer key, social login, cookies or extension-origin impersonation.
url_caution: Extension's generic normalizer discards all queries. anti social rejects identity-bearing queries before and after Darwin cleaning rather than joining unrelated pages. Host/path aliases are not proven to share server-side rooms.
validation_limit: Production read checks returned HTTP 500 and 503. No public test writes, votes, signup or credential refresh were performed. Live native identity/write compatibility remains unverified; local MockWebServer fixtures check exact request shapes and privacy boundaries.
affiliation: Independent interoperability; no claim of partnership, endorsement or control over the service.
